[list]
[*] New feature: Alpaca Taxi - With this update, we introduce the alpaca taxi. Progress through the story to unlock it and you can travel to some destinations instantaneously. 
[/list] [list]
[*] New feature: Rain - Hurray it rains! A good farmer loves a rainy day because it means that fields do not need to be watered
[/list] [list]
[*] New feature: Seed return - You feel like selling crops doesn't bring you enough profit and don't want to wait for the best market contracts? We have got you covered: Every time you harvest crops there is now a good chance that you get seeds back allowing you to farm much more without having to buy as many seed bags! The chance for getting seeds when harvesting varies between the different crops.
[/list] [list]
[*] Cheaper decorations - You love to decorate your house, but don't want to wait until you earned tons of coins at the market? Discover new furniture and farm decorations in Owen's and Amelia's store with an extra low coin price to get started and to makes things even better they also reduced prices for the existing decorations!

[*] New craft-able decorations -  Owen has a load of new stickers in his store that unlock the crafting of various farm decorations and even new building skins.
[/list] [list]

[/list] [list]
[*] Convenience: 2nd Well - What is better than one well? Two wells! Unlock a second well in the location that has the additional fields
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Fishing - You love to be a fisherman? Great news, fish will now always respawn, so you can spend the whole day fishing if you want to! 
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Building materials - Don't want to wait for getting the right materials in your market contracts? Great news, you can now craft screws and roofing shingles at your workbench.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Logs - You feel like getting logs takes too long? We've got you covered. From now on, more logs will spawn in all scenes, where you can find them.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: From now on, you get more energy from all food dishes.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Unlocking the later fields is now much cheaper.
[/list] [list]
[*] Balancing: Not needed market materials can now be sold for extra coins in Amelia's and Owen's stores.
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Animal store - In addition to giving your grown animals to the care of other farmers, you can now also earn care tokens by exchanging animal products in Jacob's store.
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Mathilda's Market - There is a new side quest asking to upgrade contract slots and sizes, because that's how you can earn much more money at the market.
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Fields - The unlock order of fields is now better visible 
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Pet list - The pet list has been cleaned up to avoid confusion
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Collision issues in mountains have been fixed, so that players won't get stuck in them 
[/list] [list]
[*] Improvements: Mo's Alpaca delivery - From now on, the alpaca delivery timer will immediately end once you go to sleep 
[/list] [list]
[*] DLC - Do you want to support the development of the game and enjoy some extra farm decorations, building skins and furniture in addition to all the free ones we added in this update? Then go check out our new optional DLC packages "Peaceful Nature" and "Pet Paradise"

Hi peeps! Today we are going to introduce you to the other regions where our partner One Tree Planted is supporting tree planting projects. Let’s check out Latin America, Africa and the Pacificːsteamhappyː. 
[list]
[*] In Latin America One Tree Planted supports projects in the Amazon Rainforest, the Andes, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Haití, Honduras, México and Perú. The focus lies on rebuilding forests and restoring land to improve the health of tropical forests. Moreover, they support the communities to improve forest management practices and agricultural techniques like agroforestry.
[/list][list]
[*] The projects in Africa are focussing on rebuilding animal habitat and restoring soil and critical watersheds. These actions also help to improve the lives of the communities as they rely on the forests. The different projects are located in Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia, Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, Tanzania and Uganda.
[/list][list]
[*] In The Pacific region, One Tree Planted supports different projects in Australia and across New Zealand. The focus is on supporting reforestation in the Pacific by restoring forests after the destruction by bushfires; regenerating critical habitat for wildlife like koalas and cockatoos; and safeguarding community watersheds through restoration of indigenous tree species.
[/list]
Thank you all for participating in our voting and supporting us in doing something good for our planet! Stay tuned for the next steps in our charity event and take care!

notes.title: Big Farm Story - Great News
notes.content:
[h3]Hi Peeps! [/h3]
First of all, thank you very much for your support since we’ve launched Big Farm Story on Steam back in August 2020. We are happy to know that we have such a great community. 
Your feedback as well as all of your ideas and suggestions were helping us a lot over the last couple of months on our exciting journey with Big Farm Story. 

Today, there is some great news we would like to share with you: [b]the Early Access phase of Big Farm Story is coming to an end soon and we are launching a full version of our game this summer![/b] After experimenting with the in-game shop for furniture items and gathering your feedback we decided to change that approach. We will remove the in-game shop with the next update and there won’t be any other ingame-purchases in the game too. We are also dedicated to removing other elements that were perceived as feeling too much like a mobile game, such as the real-time timers, and will continue to improve this based on your feedback. For example, we will soon allow you to refill your energy by eating all the delicious meals you cooked to make this feature even better!  

But now, let’s talk about the roadmap. For the big release version we are implementing lots of fan favorites and features you have asked for in the forum. Once the last big game mechanics are completed we will focus on what you requested the most: more story and things to unlock!

So, we are more than happy to share an outlook on what is yet to come in the following months: 
[list] [*] Eat your cooked food to refill your energy during the day
[/list] [list] [*] NPC friendships, quests and so much more
[/list] [list]

notes.title: Big Farm Story Update - 0.25
notes.content:
[b]A brand-new update is live, peeps. With this update, we introduce the daily cycle and the energy & sleeping system. So, prepare yourself for some major changes in Big Farm Story. Of course, we also did some fixes and improvements. Please see the full changelist:[/b]

[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Daily Cycle[/b] - With this update, we introduce the daily cycle. From now on, your day in Big Farm Story always starts at 6:00 AM and ends at 12:00 AM. In real-time, this means that an in-game day takes about 12 minutes. All in-game activities, like harvesting, crafting, gathering spots, water and animals, have been adjusted to the new cycle as well. The crops now take a certain number of in-game days to grow and need to be watered every day to make them sprout. As before, you just need to go to the well to water them. The well will be refilled after each in-game day and the water should last for all your plants. You can also upgrade your well to increase your water storage. As a last resort—if you ever run out—you can get some water at Amelia’s Store. The same procedure with the daily cycle applies to your animals. The animal products need a specific number of in-game days to be completed. You must also remember to pet your animal and give it a treat once per day—this is a crucial step. Dishes cooked in your kitchen and animal feed crafted in your mill will be finished instantly.
Some features, such as the daily goal timer, the alpaca delivery cool-down and the market refresh, have a different timer and do not depend on the daily cycle.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Energy[/b] - Another big change is that your character now needs energy to experience all the adventures in the world of Big Farm Story. To keep track of all this, check out the energy bar on your screen: it shows you when to be careful with your energy and even when you need some sleep. Imagine you are starting a brand-new morning from your cozy bed in the farmhouse, full of energy. Now you are ready for the day. But be aware the actions and things you are doing cost energy. In order to restore energy, you just need to get some sleep.
[/list]

[list]
[*] [b]Sleeping[/b] - By the time you decide to go to bed and refill your energy, your exciting day ends. You’ll get an overview of the previous day, to see what you did and achieved. In order to wake up again and start the new day, you just have to close this overview. And always keep in mind, your bed is the best place to sleep; by resting there, your energy will be fully restored. Last but not least, be aware that the day must advance to the afternoon before you can go to bed. Because who wants to go to bed early, right?
[/list]

[b]We hope you enjoy the daily cycle as much as we do.
Take care![/b]

notes.content:
